name: Cursor Usage
description:
Shows Cursor IDE plan usage percentage in the GNOME top bar.

Click the indicator for subscription type, billing cycle, Usage/API progress bars, and spend details.

* Reads the local Cursor IDE session token at runtime from ~/.config/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb (never ships credentials).
* Fetches usage over HTTPS from Cursor's undocumented dashboard API (api2.cursor.sh).
* Requires a logged-in Cursor IDE and the sqlite3 command-line tool.

Unofficial extension; not affiliated with Anysphere or Cursor.
